title: Weekday Heartbeat GPU metrics rollup (rolling 7d)
content:
SOURCE: internal "Heartbeat" dashboard export (rolling 7-day, weekdays only). Purpose: quick triage & action items for capacity planning and immediate mitigations. Not a final report — working notes and raw table included below.

RAW CSV (columns): date, region, cluster, pool, avg_gpu_util_pct, p95_inference_latency_ms, running_slots, headroom_slots, preemptible_pct, notes
2026-03-23, na, cluster-alpha, stable-inference, 58, 34, 120, 30, 10, normal
2026-03-23, eu, cluster-beta, experimental-batch, 72, 62, 80, 8, 22, evening spike from nightly retrain jobs
2026-03-23, apac, cluster-gamma, stable-inference, 91, 120, 64, 2, 40, sustained high util 18:00-02:00 local
2026-03-24, na, cluster-alpha, stable-inference, 61, 33, 122, 28, 12, slight increase from canary traffic
2026-03-24, eu, cluster-beta, experimental-batch, 70, 60, 78, 10, 20, stable
2026-03-24, apac, cluster-gamma, stable-inference, 88, 115, 66, 4, 38, preemptible eviction events: 3
2026-03-25, na, cluster-delta, dedicated-burst, 45, 27, 200, 80, 5, low utilization — consider drain for maintenance
2026-03-25, eu, cluster-beta, stable-inference, 65, 41, 95, 5, 10, small regen workload added midday
2026-03-25, apac, cluster-gamma, stable-inference, 92, 125, 63, 1, 42, sustained peak; customers routing into apac primary
2026-03-26, na, cluster-alpha, stable-inference, 80, 58, 135, 15, 20, bursty due to product experiment (AB-317)
2026-03-26, eu, cluster-epsilon, dedicated-burst, 49, 30, 150, 60, 4, normal for weekend test harness
2026-03-26, apac, cluster-gamma, experimental-batch, 95, 140, 70, 0, 48, preemptible saturation + evictions
2026-03-27, na, cluster-alpha, stable-inference, 55, 32, 118, 32, 9, catch-up from autoscaler adjustments
2026-03-27, eu, cluster-beta, stable-inference, 68, 45, 92, 8, 12, slightly elevated p95 correlating with model v2 rollout
2026-03-27, apac, cluster-zeta, stable-inference, 78, 80, 110, 10, 25, new partner onboarding traffic

QUICK OBSERVATIONS:
- APAC pressure concentrated on cluster-gamma: consistent 88-95% avg_gpu_util with p95 latency spikes (115-140ms). Headroom near zero on peak weekdays — risk of request throttles/fallbacks.
- Preemptible usage in APAC is high (~38-48%), and eviction events correspond with latency/jitter increases.
- NA clusters show healthy headroom except when product experiments push burst traffic (noted AB-317).
- EU has moderate utilization; some clusters (beta) show elevated p95 after model rollouts — need regression checks.
- Dedicated-burst pools (delta, epsilon) show low baseline utilization — potential candidates for temporary draining and rebalancing to APAC during weekdays.

RECOMMENDED ACTIONS (short term, owners):
- (P0) APAC emergency headroom: temporarily increase burst capacity + enable cross-region fallback for nondiscriminatory requests. Owner: Lars Jensen. Jira: JIRA-INFRA-9876.
- (P1) Reduce preemptible reliance for apac stable-inference pools during peak window (18:00-02:00 local). Owner: Aisha Patel. Proposal: move 20% of stable slots from preemptible -> reserved for 48h test.
- (P2) Investigate eviction root cause on cluster-gamma (node types, spot interruption signals). Owner: Maya Rodriguez. Link to SIG logs: CONFLUENCE-PLATFORM-4321.
- (P3) Evaluate draining dedicated-burst delta/epsilon to reassign nodes to APAC for 3 business days. Owner: Owen McKay. Precheck: customer SLAs and billing.
- (P4) Model rollout check for eu cluster beta — run eval suite against v2 prompts for regressions correlated to p95 rise. Owner: Eng-ML oncall. Ticket: ML-EVAL-2045.

MEASUREMENTS & NOTES ON DATA QUALITY:
- Dashboard sample includes only weekday 00:00-23:59 UTC metrics aggregated per calendar day. Nightly aggregate window differs by region timezone — may understate local peak intensity.
- Running_slots count is reported at 5-min scrape intervals and then averaged. Headroom_slots computed as pool_capacity - running_slots (pool_capacity derived from inventory DB snapshot at 03:00 UTC). There is ~1-2% mismatch occasionally due to fleet reboots.
- Preemptible_pct from scheduler label; may include recently-demoted reserved instances during scale-down. Confirm with node-meta stream for exact change events.

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS / TODOs:
- Is APAC traffic coming from new partner (zeta onboarding) or organic growth? Need CS logs correlation (CS ticket: CS-1593).
- Should we temporarily block canary traffic to apac cluster-gamma until headroom restored? Quick experiment: route canaries to na for 24h and measure error delta.
- Action owner for billing implications on draining dedicated pools? Finance contact: Priya Shah (cc).

WORKFLOW / FOLLOWUPS:
- Quick sync at 09:00 PST Monday with infra-sre, platform-engineering, and product-experiments to sign off on P0/P1 moves. Agenda: confirm burst capacity, confirm rollback plan, and prepare customer-facing note if fallback affects latency.
- After 48h, run postmortem of changes and produce a short report (confluence doc) with before/after utilization and cost delta.

SNAPSHOT LINKS (dashboard view ids): heartbeat_view: hb-2026-03-29-7d, cluster-gamma-detail: hb-gamma-2026-03-29, autoscaler-events: hb-autoscaler-2026-03-29

NOTES TO SELF: keep this export lightweight — follow with full hourly granularity slice if leadership asks. Put final recommendations into confluence under CONTINGENCY-APAC-2026-03.

END OF EXPORT
